description: Reads up to 100 active listings of one Etsy shop from Etsy's API and counts the tags and title phrases they use, each counted once per listing (tags shared by 2 or more listings, brand names flagged), with Etsy's shop sales count (the shop's lifetime total, not per listing). Tags are what the shop wrote: Etsy does not publish which tags bring sales or search traffic, so this ranks nothing. Use for 'what tags does this Etsy shop use?'.

shop.description: Etsy shop name or shop link

name: etsy_shop_tags
title: Tags an Etsy shop uses
